items.source: Constructor for MailSendException.
items.translation: MailSendException 的构造函数。

items.source:
The messages should be the same that were originally passed
to the invoked send method.
items.translation: 消息应与最初传递给调用的 `send` 方法的消息相同。

items.source:
Note that a general mail server connection failure will not result
in failed messages being returned here: A message will only be
contained here if actually sending it was attempted but failed.
items.translation: 请注意，一般的邮件服务器连接失败不会导致消息在此处返回：只有当尝试发送消息但实际发送失败时，消息才会出现在此处。

items.source: msg - the detail message
items.translation: msg - 详细信息消息

items.source: failedMessages - a Map of failed messages as keys and thrown exceptions as values
items.translation: failedMessages - 以失败的消息为键、抛出的异常为值的 Map

items.source: NOTE: This Map will not be available after serialization. Use getMessageExceptions() in such a scenario, which will be available after serialization as well.
items.translation: 注意： 此 Map 在序列化后将不可用。在此类场景中，请使用getMessageExceptions()，它在序列化后也可用。

items.source:
The messages will be the same that were originally passed to the
invoked send method, that is, SimpleMailMessages in case of using
the generic MailSender interface.
items.translation: 消息将与最初传递给被调用的 `send` 方法的原始消息相同，即在使用通用的 `MailSender` 接口时为 `SimpleMailMessages`。

items.source:
In case of sending MimeMessage instances via JavaMailSender,
the messages will be of type MimeMessage.
items.translation: 在通过 JavaMailSender 发送 MimeMessage 实例的情况下，消息的类型将为 MimeMessage。

items.source:
Exception thrown when a mail sending error is encountered.
Can register failed messages with their exceptions.
items.translation:
遇到邮件发送错误时抛出异常。
可以注册失败的消息及其异常。

items.source:
Constructor for registration of failed messages, with the
messages that failed as keys, and the thrown exceptions as values.
items.translation: 用于注册失败消息的构造函数，以失败的消息作为键，抛出的异常作为值。

items.source: cause - the root cause from the mail API in use
items.translation: cause - 正在使用的邮件 API 中的根本原因

items.source: the Map of failed messages as keys and thrown exceptions as values
items.translation: 以失败消息为键、抛出的异常为值的 Map

items.source:
the array of thrown message exceptions,
or an empty array if no failed messages
items.translation: 已抛出的消息异常数组，若无失败消息则为空数组。

items.source:
Return a Map with the failed messages as keys, and the thrown exceptions
as values.
items.translation: 返回一个 Map，以失败的消息为键，以抛出的异常为值。

items.source: Return an array with thrown message exceptions.
items.translation: 返回包含已抛出消息异常的数组。
